summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of TripZen MVP. Backend pytest: 24/24 passed (100%). Frontend mobile-web: login screen, all 3 role flows (parent home/booking/Stripe mock payment, driver start trip / scan QR / board student, admin overview/map/alerts) work correctly. Identified ONE significant bug: Sign Out is broken on web because react-native-web does not support Alert.alert with multiple buttons (the destructive 'Sign out' button onPress never fires). History tab visibility of paid bookings could not be visually verified due to tab nav focus issue but bookings ARE created+paid (confirmed via API).

ui_bugs.issue: Sign Out non-functional on web. Uses Alert.alert with 2 buttons (Cancel + destructive 'Sign out' onPress) — react-native-web only supports single-button window.alert, so the destructive button is dropped and signOut() never executes. Tested all 3 roles; URL stayed on /{role}/account after click.

issues: Expo warning in console: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' — non-blocking but should be migrated.

react_native_issues.issue: Alert.alert(title, msg, [{Cancel}, {Sign out, onPress}]) does not work on react-native-web. Replace with Platform.OS === 'web' ? window.confirm(...) : Alert.alert(...) OR a custom modal.

action_items: Fix Sign Out on web: Replace multi-button Alert.alert in /app/frontend/app/{parent,driver,admin}/account.tsx with a cross-platform confirm (e.g. `if (Platform.OS === 'web') { if (window.confirm('Sign out?')) { await signOut(); router.replace('/login'); } } else { Alert.alert(...) }`).
(Optional polish) Migrate deprecated shadow* style props to boxShadow across components.

rca_of_issue: RCA — Sign Out failure on web: handleSignOut() calls Alert.alert with [{Cancel}, {Sign out, onPress: signOut+navigate}]. On react-native-web, Alert.alert is polyfilled to call window.alert which only shows a single OK button and ignores the buttons array entirely. Therefore the destructive button's onPress (which actually clears the token and navigates) is never invoked. Reproduction: 1) Sign in as any role via demo button → tapping Sign in. 2) Tap Account tab. 3) Tap the red 'Sign out' pill at bottom. 4) Observe URL stays at /<role>/account, app still authenticated. Mitigation: Use Platform.select / Platform.OS === 'web' branch with window.confirm() (or build a small custom Modal) before invoking signOut(). Apply identical fix in parent/driver/admin account.tsx.
